questions.question: Does e2e/tests/multi-user-3p.property.spec.ts exist as a new file created by this story? Cite the file.
Does the file declare exactly one test under one test.describe.serial block (no extra tests/describes)? Cite the describe.serial and test declarations.
Does the discovered test's title contain the bracketed invariant IDs [C0,S5,S6,S7,S10]? Quote the title string.
Are three BrowserContext and three Page objects created in test.beforeAll and torn down in test.afterAll, each authenticating against its respective bunker (A/B/C)? Cite the setup/teardown.
Are cachedPubkeyA, cachedPubkeyB, cachedPubkeyC read once after authentication and stored at module scope (mirroring the 2-party pattern)? Cite the declarations and the read site.
Does RealSystem3P hold pageA/pageB/pageC and expose a page(actor: "A"|"B"|"C") accessor, mirroring the 2-party RealSystem shape without importing or mutating the 2-party file?

Does ModelState3P model a single shared group (groupId), per-actor pubkeys (pubkeyA/B/C), per-actor membership flags (memberA/B/C), per-actor epochSequence arrays, lastSwitched, and a reset() — and does it NOT carry multi-device same-pubkey state (this epic uses 3 distinct pubkeys)?

Is actor C authenticated via two-party.ts authenticate(page, E2E_BUNKER_C_URL) (which clears app state, pins a slot, and waits for __notestrTestPubkey), rather than the bare authenticateAsBunkerC which skips those steps?
Does the result.json record the bunker-setup decision (static E2E_BUNKER_*_URL constants per spec vs spawnSpecBunker), naming the KP-accumulation trade-off for S7 to watch?
Does `npx playwright test multi-user-3p.property.spec.ts --list` (or equivalent discovery) show exactly one test, and does the skeleton run/skip cleanly without a populated commands array yet?

Codex review (P2) flagged that the beforeAll authenticate(...) calls publish key packages to the SHARED E2E_BUNKER_A/B/C identities, which can accumulate stale KPs and make later specs (three-party.spec.ts, group-switch-members.spec.ts) progressively flakier — the same tension the exploration named. The implementer DELIBERATELY did NOT switch to spawnSpecBunker x3 in S1 because (a) AC-3P-FILE-4 + design-decision #8 name the static constants as the literal requirement and set spawnSpecBunker as an explicit S7 amendment, not an S1 default; (b) the S1 skeleton runs NO command loop and never invites, so it adds at most one NIP-33-replaceable KP per identity — identical load to the already-green three-party.spec.ts which uses these same constants. Verifier: confirm the static-bunker choice matches AC-3P-FILE-4, and that the KP-accumulation risk is recorded (inline comment lines ~263-280 + result.json bunker_setup_decision) for S7 wall-clock validation to watch. Is the deferral correctly surfaced rather than silently deviated?

Because e2e/ is not in the root tsconfig include and there is no e2e/tsconfig.json, the new file is transpiled by Playwright (esbuild, no full typecheck). An isolated `tsc` over the file reports the SAME window.__notestrTest* errors that the frozen two-party.ts reports under the same invocation — these vanish when src/types/notestr-test-hooks.d.ts is loaded (verified: zero errors in our file with the ambient .d.ts included). Verifier: confirm the line-197 window.__notestrTestTasks usage is the identical pattern used by the green 2-party and md templates and is NOT a real type error.
